description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to remove from the Post of Secretary to the Prime Minister
categorisation: This gazette content specifically names an individual (Mr. E. M. S. B. Ekanayake) and announces his removal from the post of Secretary to the Prime Minister. It does not describe any detailed portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas that the individual was responsible for, nor does it describe any structural changes to the government itself. The content focuses solely on a personnel change (removal from office), making it a People Gazette (Type 2).
